title: Rename test_root_vectors_use_native_addr_for_key_and_independent_signatures (now asserts upstream oracle)
description: From 1p2r.4 codereview pass 2 (security). python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:468 — after the root_signature.json corpus migrated to upstream AddrForKey and its loop was flipped to _upstream_addr_for_key, the function name still says native_addr_for_key, i.e. the rejected SHA-512 profile. The name now states the opposite of what the mixed-oracle test enforces; a future maintainer could 'fix' the oracle back to the rejected profile on the strength of the name. Rename to reflect the migration-split reality (e.g. test_root_vectors_use_addr_for_key_and_independent_signatures) once all three consumed corpora (root_signature, root_authorization, rpl_messages/authenticated_schc_dio) are on the upstream oracle, or immediately with a name that doesn't claim a single profile.
close_reason: Renamed to test_root_vectors_bind_dodagid_and_use_independent_signatures (profile-neutral; function mixes upstream oracle for root_signature.json with legacy native oracle for not-yet-migrated corpora). No dangling refs (grep). 51/51 tests pass; consolidated reviewer pass on the 2-line diff: PASS.
